# `env/` — the exported test environment

Generated by `bash scripts/export-test-env.sh` from the conda environment
`paper-refine-test`; consumed by `bash scripts/create-test-env.sh`, which recreates
the environment from these files instead of guessing versions.

Re-run the export (and commit the result) whenever the test dependencies change.

| file | what it is | use it when |
|---|---|---|
| `paper-refine-test.freeze.env_export.from_history.yml` | `conda env export --from-history`: only the packages explicitly asked for (here `python=3.12`) | **the portable, cross-machine choice** — `create-test-env.sh` pairs it with `requirements.test.txt` |
| `paper-refine-test.requirements.test.txt` | the DECLARED test dependencies and their full transitive closure, at the exact installed versions | **what `create-test-env.sh` installs** — the reproducible, portable subset |
| `paper-refine-test.freeze.env_export.no_builds.yml` | the full solve, versions pinned, build strings dropped | rebuilding on a different OS/build matrix |
| `paper-refine-test.freeze.env_export.yml` | the exact export, builds included, plus the `prefix:` of the machine it was taken on | reproducing THIS machine byte-for-byte; not portable (drop or rewrite the `prefix:` line) |
| `paper-refine-test.freeze.env_export.no_channels.yml` | the exact export with the `channels:` block removed | a box whose channel configuration must not be overridden |
| `paper-refine-test.requirements.list_e.txt` | `pip freeze --all`: every installed wheel at its exact version | the full pip record |
| `paper-refine-test.requirements.list_e_no_pypi.txt` | the same list with the conda-managed distributions removed | `pip install` into an environment whose non-Python packages came from conda |

The environment is small on purpose: the suites are standard-library-only
except `python-docx` (DOCX fixtures/scanner; it brings `lxml`) and `openpyxl`
(the pairwise workbook check).

```bash
bash scripts/create-test-env.sh              # create/recreate from these files
bash scripts/create-test-env.sh --recreate   # delete the env first, then recreate
bash scripts/export-test-env.sh              # refresh these files
```
